The transit method detects planets by measuring periodic dimming as planets cross their host stars. Radial velocity measures stellar "wobbles" caused by orbiting planets' gravitational pull. Together, these techniques account for approximately 95% of all confirmed exoplanet discoveries.

Statement 2's claim that these methods have produced "no confirmed discoveries" contradicts the well-documented scientific record entirely.
